name: Deathsight
description: Sites on ruins are known the moment you arrive. Every fight you win leaves a Remnant where it was fought.

name: Speak with the Fallen
description: At a Remnant or a ruin: every unknown fight within 8 tiles becomes known.

name: Bone Scout
description: At a Remnant: raise the fallen. The enemies in your next fight are 15% weaker.

name: Pallid Bargain
description: Sacrifice 4 party HP for 3 Essence. There is deliberately no necromantic healing.
